sentences.text: 2. On the complaint that the driver of offending vehicle- tanker bearing registration No.OR-05AS-5859 dashed against the three persons who were waiting at stoppage No.15 of Kujanga-Paradeep road and as a consequence thereof they sustained injuries.

Accordingly the petitioner, one of the injured, lodged claim application under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act,
1988 before the MACT, Cuttack which was registered as MACT No.678 of 2014/9 of 2017 (Computer No.7260 of 2014).

3. Against the award of compensation of Rs.30,000/- by the learned 3rd Additional District Judge-cum-4th MACT, Cuttack, vide Judgment dated 14.08.2019, qua the present Appellant-Sri Balaram Swain, it was directed for payment of Rs.30,000/- along with interest in cash.

4. The claimant approached this Court by way of an Appeal under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, which was registered as MACA No.627 of 2019, for enhancement of awarded amount with interest @ 8.5% per annum from the date of claim till payment.

5. With the consent of Sri Durga Charan Dey, learned counsel for the Appellant, who is physically present and on concession of the Officers of the Insurance Company, who are present today before this Lok Adalat through virtual mode, the entire claim is settled at a consolidated sum of Rs.27,000/- (Rupees Twenty Seven Thousand only).

The Insurance Company is now required to deposit said amount before the Tribunal within two months hence which shall be disbursed to the Balaram Swain vs Hemanta Kumar Nayak & on 13 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/22984456/
1 claimant by the MACT.
6.
